_meta: Looked at 960px/620px thumbnails of each. Ranked best first. Commons only; Openverse returned nothing for the Escarpment Track. Pre-filter script not run on these (candidate stage); all dated 2004+ and colour. Second judge should still run the four checks on the file page.

header.author: ELLK Photo
header.why: Wide dune-and-beach foreground with Kapiti Island centred on the horizon under dramatic sky; taken at Te Hapua Road beach access, Te Horo (Kapiti Coast), 2024; in Category:Kapiti Island. 3:2, no people or buildings.
header.notes: Subject (island) is small on horizon; centre-crop of a square still shows island plus dunes.

header.author: Thomas Roessler
header.why: Beach and dunes at Waikanae with Kapiti Island filling the middle; ~3:2; clean, no people. Categories: Kapiti Island, Waikanae, Vegetated dunes.

header.author: Panamitsu (Commons user)
header.why: 4:3 sunlit sweep of Paraparaumu Beach with the island on the horizon, bright blue sea, grass foreground; 2020.
header.notes: Parked sign/bin at right edge and a tree; island low on the horizon at upper right, so crop is off-centre.

header.file: Kapiti from Waimeha Domain, Waikanae on 7 July 2024.jpg
header.author: Commons user (CC0)
header.why: 4:3 dusk view of dark sand beach with the island centred over the water, soft sunset sky.
header.notes: Dark, low-saturation foreground; moody rather than bright.

header.file: Kapiti Island from the Maungakotukutuku Saddle, New Zealand, 3 November 2006.jpg
header.author: Phillip Capper
header.why: Green hills in the foreground with the island and blue sea beyond, 3:2, sunny with clouds; category Views of Kapiti Island.
header.notes: Hill view not a beach; 2006 (pre-2000 cutoff not hit). Island sits at the middle-left.

whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.author: Duncan (Flickr)
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.why: A takahe in long grass on Kapiti Island (description and category 'Takahe on Kapiti Island'); subject centred, sharp, bold red bill; 2010.
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.notes: Near-square 1.22:1, so crop to 1.6:1 centre trims grass top and bottom only.

whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.author: Duncan (Flickr)
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.why: Takahe on Kapiti Island (description and category 'Takahe on Kapiti Island'); 3:2 landscape, sharp, bird right of centre among flax; 2007.
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.notes: Bird off-centre to the right; may want PHOTO_FOCUS tweak. Same photographer as above, so choose only one.

whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.author: Paul O'Shea
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.why: Close-up of a kākā on a mossy trunk in Kapiti bush (category 'Kaka on Kapiti Island'); 2014.
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.notes: Square, bird at left edge: a 1.6:1 centre crop will cut the bird. Needs PHOTO_FOCUS or reject. Weakest of the three on shape.

whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.author: Peter de Lange (iNaturalist)
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.why: Little spotted kiwi (the species that lives on Kapiti); 3:2.
whyVisit1_kapiti_island_wildlife.notes: NOT VIEWED and location not confirmed as Kapiti Island (taken 2017-04-10, same day as other Kapiti Island plant records by de Lange, but unverified). Judge must open it and check; reject if captive or not Kapiti.

whyVisit2_escarpment_track.author: Daniel Walker
whyVisit2_escarpment_track.why: The suspension bridge on the Paekākāriki Escarpment Track with the cliffs falling to the Kapiti Coast sea and Pukerua Bay headland beyond; 3:2, bright, 2016; categories Escarpment Track, Kapiti Coast, Pukerua Bay.
whyVisit2_escarpment_track.notes: The only usable file for the track on Commons (all searches, categories and geosearch exhausted; Category:Escarpment Track exists but has no other >=1280px jpeg). Tiny walkers on the bridge give scale, not subjects. Openverse found nothing.
